messages:
maria_pm: Heads-up 1: customer 'Polaris' wants a pilot with hard dependencies: tenant isolation, customer KMS/HSM, and a predictable p95 for interactive UI. Need cross-team commitments before quoting dates.
aj_runtime: What p95 target and token envelope? helps decide routing fallback semantics.
maria_pm: Product request: p95 <= 230ms for <=300-token interactive traces. They allow fallback but require measured similarity thresholds (we'll hand them eval set).
sam_infra: Capacity note: we can reserve 4 GPUs (2 steady, 2 burst) with 3w lead time. Prewarm soak = 72h. If Polaris wants VPC peering add ~3 days. Need LOI to lock.
lucy_sec: Security gating: HSM attestation report, mTLS mutual auth on ingress, proof of SIEM forwarding, and automated log-scrub to ensure no key IDs. Snapshots must be sanitized.
dylan_eng: App-side: feature-flag rollout, canary at 3% for 24h, automated rollback command, and blackbox quality checks. I'll provide smoke tests + rollback script.
aj_runtime: Runtime commitments for pilot: support fp16 + q4_0 quant variants. int8/qu8 experimental and not for pilot. Routing plan: latency-first fallback to quantized model on sustained tail latency with preserved KV cache. Draft config: 
```
routing:\n  policy: "latency"\n  canary_fraction: 0.03\n  fallback:\n    trigger: "p99 > 1200ms for 5m"\n    model: "polaris-q4_0"\n    preserve_kv_cache: true\n  prewarm: true\n```
maria_pm: Draft acceptance criteria: - latency: <=230ms p95 for <=300-token traces under nominal load - isolation: tenant-dedicated compute OR VPC peering + segregated logs - keys: customer KMS/HSM + attestation - reliability: documented failover with RTO <=5m - quality: embedding cosine drop <0.05 vs baseline across eval set
sam_infra: Loadtest ask: 48h steady at 1.25x expected load + 15m spike at 3x. Schedule after LOI.
lucy_sec: I'll produce gating checklist (attestation template, mTLS test steps, CI log-scrub job) by Wed. Also require automated proof that key IDs are hashed before logs leave edge.
dylan_eng: I'll land smoke tests and rollback.sh by Thu and wire quality webhooks.
aj_runtime: I'll publish compatibility matrix + runbook by Tue and include a synthetic log-scrub run.
maria_pm: Owners & due dates: aj_runtime -> matrix + runbook (Tue); sam_infra -> capacity hold + prewarm schedule (Wed); lucy_sec -> attestation checklist + gating doc (Wed); dylan_eng -> smoke tests + rollback script (Thu); maria_pm -> finalize pilot acceptance doc and send to Polaris (Fri).
ci-bot: TASK-11011 created: "polaris-pilot-onboard" and prewarm job scheduled 2024-10-01 04:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
maria_pm: Reconvene Fri 10:00am PT to review artifacts. Thanks team :thumbsup:
